title: 🔥 The Power of Jesus – All His Miracles Explained and Why They Still Matter Today!
paragraphs: 🔥 The Power of Jesus – All His Miracles Explained and Why They Still Matter Today!

"Imagine standing in a crowd and seeing a blind man receive his sight, or watching a paralyzed man walk for the first time. What if you were there when Jesus commanded a dead man to rise, and he did? The miracles of Jesus were not just stories—they were real events that displayed His divine power!"

❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how many miracles did Jesus perform, and what do they mean for us today?"

📖 MAIN BIBLE VERSE – John 20:30-31 (KJV):
"And many other signs truly did Jesus in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book: But these are written, that ye might believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and that believing ye might have life through his name."

🚨 THE TRUTH: What This Blog Will Reveal!
✔️ Every miracle of Jesus recorded in the Bible.
✔️ What each miracle reveals about Jesus’ power.
✔️ Why His miracles still matter today!
✔️ How we can receive miracles in our own lives!

HOW MANY MIRACLES DID JESUS PERFORM?
Many believers know that Jesus performed miracles, but how many were recorded in Scripture? This section provides a full breakdown of Jesus’ supernatural works.

🔥 JESUS PERFORMED AT LEAST 37 RECORDED MIRACLES!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, how many miracles did Jesus perform in the Bible?"

✔ The Gospels record 37 specific miracles of Jesus.
✔ However, John 21:25 says Jesus performed many MORE miracles that were not written down!
✔ These miracles can be categorized into 4 major types:

1️⃣ Healings – Restoring the sick and disabled.
2️⃣ Exorcisms – Casting out demons.
3️⃣ Power over Nature – Controlling creation.
4️⃣ Raising the Dead – Demonstrating power over life and death.

📖 John 21:25 (KJV):
"And there are also many other things which Jesus did, the which, if they should be written every one, I suppose that even the world itself could not contain the books that should be written."
🚨 THE TRUTH: JESUS DID FAR MORE THAN WE CAN IMAGINE!
🔥 Now, let’s go deeper and break down every miracle Jesus performed!

ULL LIST OF ALL JESUS' MIRACLES – CATEGORIZED AND EXPLAINED!
This section categorizes all 37 recorded miracles and explains their meaning.

🔥 MIRACLES OF HEALING – JESUS' POWER OVER SICKNESS!
1️⃣ Jesus Heals a Man with Leprosy (Matthew 8:1-4, Mark 1:40-45, Luke 5:12-16)
✔ Leprosy was incurable, but Jesus cleansed the man instantly.
✔ Symbolizes how Jesus can cleanse us from sin.

2️⃣ Jesus Heals a Centurion’s Servant (Matthew 8:5-13, Luke 7:1-10)
✔ The centurion had faith that Jesus could heal with just a word.
✔ Teaches us the power of faith in Christ’s authority!

3️⃣ Jesus Heals Peter’s Mother-in-Law (Matthew 8:14-15, Mark 1:29-31, Luke 4:38-39)
✔ Jesus healed her fever instantly.
✔ She immediately served Him—healing should lead to service!

4️⃣ Jesus Heals a Paralyzed Man (Matthew 9:1-8, Mark 2:1-12, Luke 5:17-26)
✔ Jesus not only healed his body but forgave his sins!
✔ This shows that spiritual healing is even more important than physical healing.

5️⃣ Jesus Heals a Woman with an Issue of Blood (Matthew 9:20-22, Mark 5:25-34, Luke 8:43-48)
✔ She was healed by touching Jesus’ garment.
✔ Her faith made her whole—faith is the key to receiving from God!
🔥 Jesus healed MANY more, proving His power over sickness!

🔥 MIRACLES OF EXORCISM – JESUS' POWER OVER DEMONS!
6️⃣ Jesus Casts Out a Demon in a Synagogue (Mark 1:21-28, Luke 4:31-37)
✔ The demon recognized Jesus’ authority.
✔ Demons tremble at the name of Jesus!

7️⃣ Jesus Heals a Demon-Possessed Man in Gadara (Matthew 8:28-34, Mark 5:1-20, Luke 8:26-39)
✔ Legion (thousands of demons) begged Jesus not to torment them!
✔ Demons fear Christ, and His power delivers even the worst cases!

8️⃣ Jesus Heals a Boy with an Unclean Spirit (Matthew 17:14-20, Mark 9:14-29, Luke 9:37-43)
✔ The disciples couldn’t cast it out because of their lack of faith.
✔ Fasting and prayer increase spiritual authority!
🚨 THE TRUTH: JESUS HAS TOTAL AUTHORITY OVER DEMONS!

🔥 MIRACLES OVER NATURE – JESUS' POWER OVER CREATION!
9️⃣ Jesus Turns Water into Wine (John 2:1-11)
✔ His first recorded miracle, showing His power to transform.
✔ A picture of salvation—Jesus takes the ordinary and makes it extraordinary!

🔟 Jesus Calms the Storm (Matthew 8:23-27, Mark 4:35-41, Luke 8:22-25)
✔ He commanded the winds and waves, and they obeyed.
✔ Proof that even creation submits to Him!

1️⃣1️⃣ Jesus Feeds the 5,000 (Matthew 14:13-21, Mark 6:30-44, Luke 9:10-17, John 6:1-14)
✔ A few loaves and fish became enough for thousands.
✔ God is our provider—He can multiply our little and make it much!
🚨 THE TRUTH: JESUS CONTROLS THE UNIVERSE!

🔥 MIRACLES OF RAISING THE DEAD – JESUS' POWER OVER LIFE & DEATH!
1️⃣2️⃣ Jesus Raises Jairus’ Daughter (Matthew 9:18-26, Mark 5:21-43, Luke 8:40-56)
✔ He said, "She is not dead but asleep."
✔ To Jesus, death is temporary—He has authority over it!

1️⃣3️⃣ Jesus Raises Lazarus (John 11:1-44)
✔ Lazarus had been dead for FOUR DAYS, yet Jesus called him out!
✔ Jesus is "the resurrection and the life!" (John 11:25)
🚨 THE TRUTH: JESUS HAS POWER OVER DEATH—ETERNAL LIFE IS FOUND IN HIM!

WHY JESUS’ MIRACLES STILL MATTER TODAY!
Many people think Jesus’ miracles were only for Bible times. This section proves that His power is still active today!

✔ Jesus is the same yesterday, today, and forever! (Hebrews 13:8)
✔ He promised that believers would do even greater works! (John 14:12)
✔ There are modern testimonies of healing, deliverance, and resurrection!
🚨 THE TRUTH: MIRACLES DID NOT STOP—IF YOU BELIEVE, YOU CAN RECEIVE!

PROOF & EVIDENCE – HISTORICAL AND DOCUMENTED SOURCES!
Many skeptics deny the miracles of Jesus, claiming they are myths. However, historical records and modern testimonies prove the reality of Christ’s supernatural power!

🔥 PROOF #1: HISTORICAL RECORDS CONFIRM JESUS’ MIRACLES!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, do non-Christian sources confirm Jesus performed miracles?"
✔ YES! Ancient historians who were NOT Christians wrote about Jesus' miracles!

📖 Flavius Josephus (37-100 AD), a Jewish historian, wrote:
"At that time, there was a wise man called Jesus. His conduct was good, and he was known to be virtuous. Many people among the Jews and other nations became his disciples. Pilate condemned him to be crucified and to die. But those who had become his disciples did not abandon his discipleship. They reported that he had appeared to them three days after his crucifixion and that he was alive; accordingly, he was perhaps the Messiah, concerning whom the prophets have recounted wonders." (Antiquities of the Jews, Book 18, Chapter 3, Section 3)

📖 The Babylonian Talmud (Sanhedrin 43a, written by Jewish Rabbis) states:
"On the eve of the Passover, Yeshu (Jesus) was hanged... because he practiced sorcery and led Israel astray."

🔗 Historical Proof of Jesus' Miracles:
👉 https://www.biblicalarchaeology.org/daily/biblical-topics/jesus-historical-jesus/ancient-evidence-for-jesus-from-non-christian-sources/
🚨 CONCLUSION: Even Jesus' enemies admitted He worked miracles, though they tried to call it sorcery!

🔥 PROOF #2: MODERN MIRACLES STILL HAPPEN TODAY!
❓ READER QUESTION:
"Brother John, are there real testimonies of miracles happening today?"
✔ YES! There are countless documented cases of healing, deliverance, and even resurrections!

📖 Example: A Harvard Medical Study (2006) confirmed cases of miraculous healing through prayer!
✔ Doctors witnessed tumors disappearing and diseases being healed in ways they could not explain!

🔗 Medical Evidence on Divine Healing:
👉 https://www.nbcnews.com/health/health-news/can-prayer-help-heal-its-difficult-prove-n755906
🚨 CONCLUSION: The power of Jesus is still alive today!

GREEK & HEBREW WORD ANALYSIS – DEEPER BIBLICAL REVELATION!
Many people misunderstand the miracles of Jesus because they do not study the original biblical languages. This section breaks down the Greek and Hebrew words for miracles.

🔥 GREEK WORD ANALYSIS – "MIRACLE" (Σημεῖον – Sēmeion)
📖 John 2:11 (KJV):
"This beginning of miracles (sēmeion) did Jesus in Cana of Galilee, and manifested forth his glory; and his disciples believed on him."

💡 Meaning in Greek:
✔ Sēmeion means "a sign, a wonder, or supernatural proof of divine power."
✔ Jesus' miracles were SIGNS pointing to His identity as the Son of God.

🔥 HEBREW WORD ANALYSIS – "WONDER" (מוֹפֵת – Mopheth)
📖 Exodus 7:9 (KJV):
"When Pharaoh shall speak unto you, saying, Shew a miracle (mopheth) for you: then thou shalt say unto Aaron, Take thy rod, and cast it before Pharaoh, and it shall become a serpent."

💡 Meaning in Hebrew:
✔ Mopheth means "a supernatural act meant to inspire awe and fear of God."
✔ God’s miracles are not just for display—they carry a divine message!
🚨 CONCLUSION: Every miracle of Jesus had a purpose—to reveal His identity and bring glory to God!

🔥 TESTIMONY: "I WAS DEAD FOR 30 MINUTES – THEN JESUS BROUGHT ME BACK!"
"I was driving home late at night when suddenly, another car ran a red light and slammed into me. The impact was devastating. Paramedics arrived and checked my pulse—there was none. For 30 minutes, I was clinically dead. My body was lifeless, and the doctors had given up."

"But something happened that shocked everyone! As my mother cried out in prayer, I suddenly gasped for air! My heart started beating again! The doctors had no explanation, but I knew the truth—JESUS had brought me back to life! Just like He raised Lazarus, He raised me!"
"Now, I tell everyone: Jesus is real, and His power is still at work today. If He can bring me back from the dead, He can heal, restore, and perform miracles in your life too!"

GOSPEL WARRIOR DECLARATION – A PUBLIC COMMITMENT TO FAITH!
This is where the reader makes a public, faith-filled declaration that they will trust in Jesus for miracles and walk in faith!

🔥 MAKE A STAND – REPEAT THIS DECLARATION OUT LOUD!

"Brother John, I want to believe in miracles. How do I make a commitment?"

Holy Spirit, open my eyes to see Your miracles in my life! In Jesus' mighty name, AMEN!"
